implement.phase: The delegated builder must atomically claim the task before any write
entry_criteria: Load the Beads task and confirm it is ready, blockers are closed

loop-engineering.phase: Trigger -> Planner -> Builder -> Independent Verifier -> Memory -> Manager -> Controller.
entry_criteria: Beads is the sole durable runtime state.
exit_criteria: Emit and persist exactly one transition: CONTINUE, REWORK, REPLAN, WAIT, COMPLETE, ESCALATE, or ABORT.

checks.command: python3 -c "import json; [json.loads(l) for l in open('.beads/issues.jsonl') if l.strip()]"  # Beads JSONL integrity

research.phase: This phase delegates to repository-researcher in an isolated read-only session.
entry_criteria: Load the Beads run/task, spec, prior transitions, failures, evidence signatures, and budget.
exit_criteria: Return observed facts, inferences, constraints, tools/skills, verification commands, failure chronology, later-added evidence, risks, unknowns, and the smallest bounded task contract.

verify.phase: Delegate to independent-verifier in a new isolated session.
entry_criteria: Load the task, actual diff, builder_session, candidate evidence, prior verdicts, failure/evidence signatures, and budget.
exit_criteria: Persist criterion evidence and exactly one verdict: ACCEPTED, REWORK, REPLAN, BLOCKED, or ESCALATE.
